name: codeindex
description: Skills that teach any agent to answer code questions structurally instead of reading whole files — symbol lookup, callers, imports and blast radius. Bundles the codeindex MCP server so install wires everything in one step.

enforce.title: Refuse a scan the index answers better
enforce.description: On: an identifier search that is the whole command line is refused, and the agent is given the structural call that answers it. Never refuses a file read, never refuses a line that also builds or tests, and stops after three refusals in a session. Off: the hooks only advise.
